title: Slack App-level token: one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: a letter glued directly before xapp-, so the prefix is no longer at a token boundary (the value itself is unchanged). Twin of "Slack App-level token: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of slack-app-level-token-agent-yaml: boundary: a letter glued directly before xapp-, so the prefix is no longer at a token boundary (the value itself is unchanged). Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
